propositions: test_pass_summary_reports_the_decline_count fails intermittently under xdist with -n 3 --dist worksteal but passes in isolation due to logger level leakage from prior tests
rebar_reconciler root logger is set to WARNING by install_stderr_handler and never restored, poisoning all later tests in the same xdist worker
caplog.at_level(INFO) without logger argument only raises ROOT logger level, so INFO records from rebar_reconciler are dropped at source before handlers see them while WARNING records propagate
existing log containment guard _rebar_log_propagation_guard only protects rebar root but not sibling rebar_reconciler root, leaving reconciler INFO assertions unprotected
fix generalizes the log integrity guard from single root to tuple of shared roots and updates level snapshot/restore to operate over all protected loggers
